meta.name: ChatBI starter eval set
meta.note: example.db 中 ORDER_DETAILS 仅 4 条落在 2024 年，PAYMENT_DATE 全部在 2025 年。涉及时间的问题请以 2025 年数据为主，避免『2024年各月』这类极度稀疏的口径。

questions.question: 订单表里一共有多少条订单记录？
所有商品的平均价格是多少？
2024年一共有多少笔订单？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDER_DETAILS WHERE ORDER_DATE LIKE '2024%'

questions.question: 每个商品类别各有多少种商品？
questions.gold_sql: SELECT CATEGORY, COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCTS GROUP BY CATEGORY

questions.question: 订单总金额最高的前3位客户是谁？列出客户姓名和对应总金额。
questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.FIRST_NAME, c.LAST_NAME, SUM(o.TOTAL_AMOUNT) AS total FROM CUSTOMER_DETAILS c JOIN ORDER_DETAILS o ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = o.CUSTOMER_ID GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: 按销售数量排名，销量最高的前5个商品是哪些？列出商品名和销售总数量。
questions.gold_sql: SELECT p.PRODUCT_NAME, SUM(t.QUANTITY) AS total_qty FROM TRANSACTIONS t JOIN PRODUCTS p ON t.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID GROUP BY t.PRODUCT_ID ORDER BY total_qty DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: 每个商品类别的总销售金额分别是多少？列出类别和总金额。
questions.gold_sql: SELECT p.CATEGORY, SUM(t.QUANTITY * t.PRICE) AS revenue FROM TRANSACTIONS t JOIN PRODUCTS p ON t.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID GROUP BY p.CATEGORY

questions.question: 购买商品总数量超过15件的订单有哪些？列出订单号和总数量。
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ORDER_ID, SUM(QUANTITY) AS total_qty FROM TRANSACTIONS GROUP BY ORDER_ID HAVING SUM(QUANTITY) > 15 ORDER BY ORDER_ID

questions.question: 销售额最高的那个商品是什么？给出商品名。
questions.gold_sql: SELECT p.PRODUCT_NAME FROM TRANSACTIONS t JOIN PRODUCTS p ON t.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID GROUP BY t.PRODUCT_ID ORDER BY SUM(t.QUANTITY * t.PRICE) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: 2025年每个月的订单总金额分别是多少？按月列出月份和总金额。
questions.gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%m', ORDER_DATE) AS month, SUM(TOTAL_AMOUNT) AS total FROM ORDER_DETAILS WHERE ORDER_DATE LIKE '2025%' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
